items.caption:
POV: tired at 9, awake at 11.
Sleep researchers describe a stretch in the hours before your usual bedtime, the "forbidden zone", when the body clock pushes alertness up; later a "sleep gate" opens (Lavie, 1986; Monterastelli et al., 2023). The times shown are an example and differ from person to person.
